intent: Apply the GitHub/Pen receipt doctrine, handoff/runtime closure split, no-default-email rule, anti-orphan queue model, and out-of-band policy beyond T4H Comms Hub across the portfolio.
core_rule: The doctrine applies to every system where work can be created, changed, published, deployed, automated, relied on, or used as evidence.

applies_immediately_to_categories.reason: These systems coordinate work and must not run on invisible state.

applies_immediately_to_categories.category: Bridge, workers, queues and runtime automation
applies_immediately_to_categories.reason: These execute work and must produce acceptance, runtime, and failure receipts.
Public claims and publications require source, schema, deploy, and evidence linkage.
Customer-facing surfaces need deploy receipts, ownership, monitoring, rollback, and drift detection.
Research outputs must carry manifest, provenance, version, and evidence classification.
Demos become operational debt if not receipted, classified, and retired or promoted.
Anything that captures demand, sells, assesses, or routes customers requires stronger evidence and change control.
Public identity surfaces need publication, deploy, and drift receipts even if lightweight.
They are source-of-truth surfaces and must enforce the doctrine, not merely follow it.

does_not_need_full_runtime_doctrine_when: pure scratch notes not promoted to Pen, Dev, Prod, public, evidence, customer, finance, compliance, or automation use
throwaway local exploration with no artefact, no deployment, and no downstream reliance
private reasoning that is not represented as an artifact or action
must_apply_when_any_condition_is_true: Supabase table or row is touched
customer/user/business process may rely on it
automation or worker may run it
it may be promoted from Pen to Dev or Dev to Prod
it changes a product, brand, offer, price, domain, deployment, config, schema, queue, worker, or dashboard

tier_1_handoff: expected runtime receipt path if applicable

out_of_band_policy: Any work or change outside the receipt path is OUT_OF_BAND_UNTRUSTED until reconciled, backfilled with evidence, or rolled back.
receipt_delivery_policy: Default delivery is in-thread plus GitHub/Pen. Do not email receipts by default. Use troy@tech4humanity.com.au only when explicitly requested or workflow-required.
next_bridge_actions: Register this applicability matrix as portfolio-wide doctrine.
Backfill each active Vercel project into a receipt/doctrine coverage register.
Open remediation jobs for projects missing canonical source, owner/lane, health check, rollback target, or latest receipt.
Add stale-worker detection for Pen jobs with no runtime receipt.
Expose coverage status in Command Centre.
